ef_market_copperwife: Sheet, band, collar, wire. If it is copper and it is in Caelora, it likely came off our floor.
There is a house in Aureline that sells ours at four times the price and calls it northern work.
ef_market_charcoal: A sack of charcoal costs more here than a sack of copper does in Briarbell.
Everybody finds that funny exactly once.
ef_market_foreigner: Three months east of here there are reaches nobody in this market has heard of. Different Kin, different leagues, different everything.
And the first thing I saw when I got here was a woman walking water downhill.
Nobody does that at home. Nobody at home has water that needs it.
ef_market_child: Mum sells collars. I am allowed to shout the prices but not to say them wrong.
